# 1. Data loading / 数据读取

Region CSS tables are the analysis unit for alpha/beta (sample-level
genus >= 2 QC; 101 samples fewer than metadata). `SampleID` is **not**
unique across kingdoms, so every metadata match is done within `dataset`.

```{r data}
REG_FILES <- c(
  V3_V4 = "css_v3_v4_asvtab.txt", V4 = "css_v4_asvtab.txt",
  V5_V6 = "css_v5_v6_asvtab.txt", V5_V7 = "css_v5_v7_asvtab.txt",
  ITS1  = "css_its1_asvtab.txt",   ITS2 = "css_its2_asvtab.txt"
)
REG_DS <- c(V3_V4 = "16S", V4 = "16S", V5_V6 = "16S", V5_V7 = "16S",
            ITS1 = "ITS", ITS2 = "ITS")
REG_TREE <- c(V3_V4 = "plant_species_tree_all.nwk",
              V4    = "plant_species_tree_v4.nwk",
              V5_V6 = "plant_species_tree_all.nwk",
              V5_V7 = "plant_species_tree_v5_v7.nwk",
              ITS1  = "plant_species_tree_its1.nwk",
              ITS2  = "plant_species_tree_all.nwk")

md_all <- read_all_meta()

region_ids <- setNames(lapply(names(REG_FILES), function(reg) {
  setdiff(names(fread(css_region_path(tolower(reg), REG_FILES[[reg]]), nrows = 1)), "ASV_ID")
}), names(REG_FILES))
cat("region samples:", paste(names(region_ids), lengths(region_ids),
                             sep = "=", collapse = "  "), "\n")

# sample registry restricted to region-table samples (dataset-aware)
registry <- rbindlist(lapply(names(region_ids), function(reg) {
  md_all[dataset == REG_DS[[reg]] & SampleID %in% region_ids[[reg]]]
}))
cat("registry:", nrow(registry), "samples\n")
stopifnot(!anyNA(registry$Genus), all(registry$Genus != ""))

load_region <- function(reg) {
  raw <- fread(css_region_path(tolower(reg), REG_FILES[[reg]]))
  ids <- names(raw)[-1]
  m <- md_all[dataset == REG_DS[[reg]] & SampleID %in% ids]
  m <- m[match(ids, m$SampleID)]
  stopifnot(nrow(m) == length(ids), identical(m$SampleID, ids))
  mat <- t(as.matrix(raw[, -1]))
  colnames(mat) <- raw[[1]]
  rownames(mat) <- ids
  rm(raw); invisible(gc())
  list(mat = mat, meta = m[])
}

# ---- Part A units: source x kingdom, >=2 host genera with >=3 samples ----
qualified_genus <- function(m) {
  m[, .N, by = Genus][N >= 3, Genus]
}
units <- registry[, {
  gq <- qualified_genus(.SD)
  if (length(gq) < 2) NULL else .(Region = Region[1], Cite = Cite[1])
}, by = .(dataset, source)]
units[, `:=`(unit = paste(Region, source, sep = ":"),
             kingdom = ifelse(dataset == "16S", "Bacteria", "Fungi"))]
setorder(units, dataset, Region, source)
cat("Part A units:", nrow(units), "| unique sources:",
    uniqueN(units$source), "| samples:",
    registry[source %in% units$source, .N], "\n")
print(units[, .(dataset, Region, source, Cite)])
```

```{r helpers}
vary_covars <- function(m) {
  cand <- c("Country", "extract", "IF_SD", "PlatformN")
  n <- nrow(m)
  keep <- vapply(cand, function(v) {
    x <- droplevels(factor(m[[v]]))
    if (nlevels(x) < 2) return(FALSE)
    if (nlevels(x) > max(2, floor(n / 5))) return(FALSE)
    m[, uniqueN(get(v)), by = Genus][V1 > 1, .N] > 0
  }, logical(1))
  cand[keep]
}

covar_df <- function(m, vars) {
  if (!length(vars)) return(data.frame(row.names = seq_len(nrow(m))))
  d <- as.data.frame(m[, ..vars])
  for (v in vars) d[[v]] <- droplevels(factor(d[[v]]))
  d
}

keep2 <- function(cd) {
  if (!ncol(cd)) return(cd)
  ok <- vapply(cd, function(x) nlevels(droplevels(factor(x))) >= 2, logical(1))
  cd[, ok, drop = FALSE]
}

adonis_marg <- function(D, g, cd, nperm = N_PERM) {
  g <- droplevels(factor(g))
  if (nlevels(g) < 2)
    return(data.frame(R2 = NA_real_, `Pr(>F)` = NA_real_, Df = 0))
  cd <- keep2(cd)
  d <- data.frame(g = g)
  if (ncol(cd)) for (v in names(cd)) d[[v]] <- droplevels(factor(cd[[v]]))
  rhs <- c("g", names(cd))
  f <- as.formula(paste("D ~", paste(rhs, collapse = " + ")))
  a <- as.data.frame(adonis2(f, data = d, by = "margin",
                             permutations = nperm))
  a$term <- rownames(a)
  a[a$term == "g", c("R2", "Pr(>F)", "Df")]
}

icc_moment <- function(y, g) {
  g <- droplevels(factor(g))
  if (nlevels(g) < 2) return(0)
  a <- anova(lm(y ~ g))
  if (nrow(a) < 2) return(0)
  msb <- a[1, "Mean Sq"]; msw <- a[2, "Mean Sq"]
  if (!is.finite(msb) || !is.finite(msw) || msb + msw == 0) return(0)
  n_i <- table(g); N <- sum(n_i); k <- length(n_i)
  k0 <- (N - sum(n_i^2) / N) / (k - 1)
  icc <- (msb - msw) / (msb + (k0 - 1) * msw)
  max(0, min(1, icc))
}

fit_icc <- function(y, g, cd) {
  cd <- keep2(cd)
  d <- data.frame(y = y, g = droplevels(factor(g)))
  if (ncol(cd)) for (v in names(cd)) d[[v]] <- droplevels(factor(cd[[v]]))
  rhs <- c(if (ncol(cd)) names(cd), "(1|g)")
  f <- as.formula(paste("y ~", paste(rhs, collapse = " + ")))
  out <- tryCatch({
    m <- suppressWarnings(lmer(f, data = d, REML = TRUE))
    vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(m))
    vg <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "g"]; vr <- vc$vcov[vc$grp == "Residual"]
    if (!length(vg) || !length(vr) || !is.finite(vg) || !is.finite(vr))
      stop("bad variance components")
    vg / (vg + vr)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(out) || !is.finite(out)) out <- icc_moment(y, g)
  max(0, min(1, out))
}

boot_icc <- function(y, g, cd, B = B_ICC) {
  n <- length(y)
  v <- vapply(seq_len(B), function(b) {
    i <- sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE)
    if (uniqueN(g[i]) < 2) return(NA_real_)
    cd_b <- if (ncol(cd)) cd[i, , drop = FALSE] else cd
    fit_icc(y[i], g[i], cd_b)
  }, numeric(1))
  v <- v[is.finite(v)]
  c(est = mean(v), lo = as.numeric(quantile(v, 0.025)),
    hi = as.numeric(quantile(v, 0.975)), se = sd(v))
}

delta_effect <- function(D, grp) {
  ut <- upper.tri(D)
  same <- outer(grp, grp, "==")
  w <- mean(D[ut & same]); b <- mean(D[ut & !same])
  if (!is.finite(w) || !is.finite(b) || w <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  log(b / w)
}

boot_delta <- function(D, grp, B = B_DELTA) {
  n <- nrow(D)
  v <- vapply(seq_len(B), function(b) {
    i <- sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE)
    if (uniqueN(grp[i]) < 2) return(NA_real_)
    dd <- D[i, i, drop = FALSE]
    ss <- outer(grp[i], grp[i], "==")
    # resampled copies of the same sample have distance 0; those self-pairs
    # would deflate the within-group mean and bias Delta upward
    dup <- outer(i, i, "==")
    uu <- upper.tri(dd) & !dup
    w <- mean(dd[uu & ss]); btw <- mean(dd[uu & !ss])
    if (!is.finite(w) || !is.finite(btw) || w <= 0) return(NA_real_)
    log(btw / w)
  }, numeric(1))
  v <- v[is.finite(v)]
  c(est = delta_effect(D, grp),
    lo = as.numeric(quantile(v, 0.025)),
    hi = as.numeric(quantile(v, 0.975)), se = sd(v))
}

meta_fit <- function(yi, sei) {
  ok <- is.finite(yi) & is.finite(sei) & sei > 0
  yi <- yi[ok]; sei <- sei[ok]; k <- length(yi)
  if (k == 0) return(c(est = NA, lo = NA, hi = NA, tau2 = NA, I2 = NA,
                       Q = NA, k = 0))
  if (k < 3) return(c(est = mean(yi), lo = mean(yi) - 1.96 * mean(sei),
                      hi = mean(yi) + 1.96 * mean(sei), tau2 = NA,
                      I2 = NA, Q = NA, k = k))
  m <- metafor::rma(yi = yi, sei = sei, method = "REML")
  c(est = as.numeric(m$beta), lo = m$ci.lb, hi = m$ci.ub,
    tau2 = m$tau2, I2 = m$I2, Q = m$QE, k = k)
}
```

# 2. Part A - within-study host effect / 研究内宿主效应

```{r part-a}
rds_a <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "partA_units.rds")
rds_b <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "partB_pools.rds")

if (file.exists(rds_a) && file.exists(rds_b) && !FORCE) {
  A <- readRDS(rds_a); B <- readRDS(rds_b)
  cat("Part A/B loaded from cache\n")
} else {
  # ---- Part B pool definitions (>=5 sources per Genus x Region) ----
  pool_def <- registry[, .(n_sources = uniqueN(source)),
                       by = .(dataset, Region, Genus)]
  pool_def <- pool_def[n_sources >= 5]
  pool_def[, pool := paste(Genus, "x", Region)]
  setorder(pool_def, dataset, Region, Genus)
  cat("Part B pools:", nrow(pool_def), "| samples:",
      sum(pool_def$n_sources), "(source counts)\n")
  print(pool_def)

  eff_rows <- list(); sample_rows <- list(); pcoa_rows <- list()
  mant_rows <- list()
  b_eff <- list(); b_ad <- list(); b_comp <- list()

  for (reg in names(region_ids)) {
    if (!any(units$Region == reg) && !any(pool_def$Region == reg)) next
    rd <- load_region(reg)
    cat(sprintf("---- [%s] %d x %d ----\n", reg, nrow(rd$mat),
                ncol(rd$mat)))

    # ================= Part A units in this region =================
    for (k in which(units$Region == reg)) {
      src <- units$source[k]
      progress("START unit", units$unit[k])
      m <- rd$meta[source == src]
      gq <- qualified_genus(m)
      mu <- m[Genus %in% gq]
      idx <- match(mu$SampleID, rownames(rd$mat))
      mat <- rd$mat[idx, , drop = FALSE]
      mu[, `:=`(Shannon = diversity(mat, "shannon"),
                Observed = rowSums(mat > 0))]
      mu[, logObs := log10(Observed)]
      D <- as.matrix(vegdist(mat, "bray"))

      cv <- vary_covars(mu)
      cd <- covar_df(mu, cv)
      grp <- droplevels(factor(mu$Genus))
      n_sp <- uniqueN(mu$species)

      sample_rows[[length(sample_rows) + 1]] <- mu[
        , .(unit = units$unit[k], dataset = units$dataset[k],
            Region = reg, source = src, SampleID, Genus, species, Country,
            extract, IF_SD, PlatformN, Shannon, Observed, logObs)]

      for (ix in c("Shannon", "logObs")) {
        y  <- mu[[ix]]
        icc <- fit_icc(y, grp, cd)
        bi  <- boot_icc(y, grp, cd)
        ar  <- adonis_marg(as.dist(dist(y)), grp, cd,
                           nperm = N_PERM_ALPHA)
        eff_rows[[length(eff_rows) + 1]] <- data.table(
          unit = units$unit[k], dataset = units$dataset[k], Region = reg,
          source = src,
          index = ifelse(ix == "Shannon", "Shannon", "Observed (log10)"),
          ICC = icc, ICC_lo = bi[["lo"]], ICC_hi = bi[["hi"]],
          ICC_se = bi[["se"]], alpha_R2 = ar$R2, alpha_P = ar$`Pr(>F)`,
          covars = paste(cv, collapse = "+"))
      }

      bd <- boot_delta(D, grp)
      br <- adonis_marg(as.dist(D), grp, cd)
      eff_rows[[length(eff_rows) + 1]] <- data.table(
        unit = units$unit[k], dataset = units$dataset[k], Region = reg,
        source = src, index = "beta_delta_host",
        ICC = bd[["est"]], ICC_lo = bd[["lo"]], ICC_hi = bd[["hi"]],
        ICC_se = bd[["se"]], alpha_R2 = br$R2, alpha_P = br$`Pr(>F)`,
        covars = paste(cv, collapse = "+"))

      pc <- cmdscale(D, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
      eigp <- pc$eig[pc$eig > 0]
      pcoa_rows[[length(pcoa_rows) + 1]] <- data.table(
        unit = units$unit[k], SampleID = rownames(pc$points),
        PCoA1 = pc$points[, 1], PCoA2 = pc$points[, 2],
        var1 = 100 * eigp[1] / sum(eigp),
        var2 = 100 * eigp[2] / sum(eigp), Genus = mu$Genus)

      # ---- within-study phylogenetic signal (species >= 8) ----
      if (n_sp >= 8) {
        cnt <- table(mu$species)
        cen <- rowsum(mat, mu$species) / as.vector(cnt)
        tree <- read.tree(host_tree_path(REG_TREE[[reg]]))
        sp <- intersect(rownames(cen), tree$tip.label)
        if (length(sp) >= 8) {
          Db <- as.matrix(vegdist(cen[sp, , drop = FALSE], "bray"))
          Ct <- cophenetic(keep.tip(tree, sp))
          Ct <- Ct[sp, sp, drop = FALSE]
          mt <- mantel(Db, Ct, method = "pearson",
                       permutations = N_PERM_MANTEL)
          mant_rows[[length(mant_rows) + 1]] <- data.table(
            unit = units$unit[k], dataset = units$dataset[k], Region = reg,
            source = src, n_species = length(sp), n_samples = nrow(mu),
            mantel_r = as.numeric(mt$statistic),
            mantel_P = as.numeric(mt$signif))
        }
      }
      cat(sprintf("  A [%s] n=%d G=%d sp=%d covars=%s\n", units$unit[k],
                  nrow(mu), nlevels(grp), n_sp,
                  ifelse(length(cv), paste(cv, collapse = "+"), "-")))
      progress("DONE unit", units$unit[k])
    }

    # ================= Part B pools in this region =================
    for (k in which(pool_def$Region == reg)) {
      gen <- pool_def$Genus[k]
      progress("START pool", pool_def$pool[k])
      m <- rd$meta[Genus == gen]
      idx <- match(m$SampleID, rownames(rd$mat))
      mat <- rd$mat[idx, , drop = FALSE]
      D <- as.matrix(vegdist(mat, "bray"))

      terms_all <- c(source = "source", country = "Country",
                     extract = "extract", IF_SD = "IF_SD",
                     platform = "PlatformN")
      terms_all <- terms_all[vapply(terms_all, function(v)
        uniqueN(m[[v]]) >= 2, logical(1))]
      cd <- covar_df(m, unname(terms_all))
      f <- as.formula(paste("as.dist(D) ~",
                            paste(names(cd), collapse = " + ")))
      ad <- adonis2(f, data = cd, by = "margin",
                    permutations = N_PERM)
      adt <- as.data.frame(ad); adt$term <- rownames(adt)
      adt <- adt[!adt$term %in% c("Residual", "Total"), ]

      b_ad[[length(b_ad) + 1]] <- data.table(
        pool = pool_def$pool[k], dataset = pool_def$dataset[k],
        Region = reg, Genus = gen, term = adt$term, Df = adt$Df,
        R2 = adt$R2, P = adt$`Pr(>F)`)

      for (tn in names(terms_all)) {
        v <- terms_all[[tn]]
        grp <- droplevels(factor(m[[v]]))
        bd <- boot_delta(D, grp)
        row <- match(v, adt$term)
        b_eff[[length(b_eff) + 1]] <- data.table(
          pool = pool_def$pool[k], dataset = pool_def$dataset[k],
          Region = reg, Genus = gen, term = tn,
          n_levels = nlevels(grp), n = nrow(m),
          delta = bd[["est"]], lo = bd[["lo"]], hi = bd[["hi"]],
          se = bd[["se"]],
          R2 = if (is.na(row)) NA_real_ else adt$R2[row],
          P  = if (is.na(row)) NA_real_ else adt$`Pr(>F)`[row])
      }
      b_comp[[length(b_comp) + 1]] <- data.table(
        pool = pool_def$pool[k], dataset = pool_def$dataset[k], Region = reg,
        Genus = gen, n_samples = nrow(m), n_sources = uniqueN(m$source),
        n_countries = uniqueN(m$Country),
        extract = paste(sort(unique(m$extract)), collapse = "+"),
        IF_SD = paste(sort(unique(m$IF_SD)), collapse = "+"),
        platform = paste(sort(unique(m$PlatformN)), collapse = "+"),
        terms_ok = paste(names(terms_all), collapse = "+"))
      cat(sprintf("  B [%s] n=%d src=%d terms=%s\n", pool_def$pool[k],
                  nrow(m), uniqueN(m$source),
                  paste(names(terms_all), collapse = "+")))
      progress("DONE pool", pool_def$pool[k])
    }
    rm(rd); invisible(gc())
  }

  A <- list(effects = rbindlist(eff_rows),
            samples = rbindlist(sample_rows),
            pcoa = rbindlist(pcoa_rows),
            units = units, mantel = rbindlist(mant_rows))
  B <- list(effects = rbindlist(b_eff), adonis = rbindlist(b_ad),
            composition = rbindlist(b_comp), pool_def = pool_def)
  saveRDS(A, rds_a); saveRDS(B, rds_b)
}
```

```{r part-a-meta}
ae <- copy(A$effects)
ae[index != "beta_delta_host",
   alpha_q := p.adjust(alpha_P, "BH"), by = index]
ae[index == "beta_delta_host",
   beta_q := p.adjust(alpha_P[index == "beta_delta_host"], "BH")]
ae[, sig := alpha_q < 0.05]

a_alpha <- ae[index != "beta_delta_host"]
a_beta  <- ae[index == "beta_delta_host"]
n_by_unit <- A$samples[, .N, by = unit]

meta_icc <- rbindlist(lapply(split(a_alpha, a_alpha$index), function(d) {
  z  <- atanh(pmin(d$ICC, 1 - 1e-6))
  n  <- n_by_unit$N[match(d$unit, n_by_unit$unit)]
  se <- pmax(d$ICC_se / (1 - pmin(d$ICC, 1 - 1e-6)^2), 1 / sqrt(n))
  mz <- meta_fit(z, se)
  data.table(index = d$index[1], est = tanh(mz[["est"]]),
             lo = tanh(mz[["lo"]]), hi = tanh(mz[["hi"]]),
             tau2 = mz[["tau2"]], I2 = mz[["I2"]], k = mz[["k"]])
}))
mb <- meta_fit(a_beta$ICC, a_beta$ICC_se)
meta_beta <- data.table(est = mb[["est"]], lo = mb[["lo"]],
                        hi = mb[["hi"]], tau2 = mb[["tau2"]],
                        I2 = mb[["I2"]], Q = mb[["Q"]], k = mb[["k"]],
                        index = "beta_delta_host")
A$meta_icc <- meta_icc; A$meta_beta <- meta_beta
saveRDS(A[c("meta_icc", "meta_beta")],
        file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "partA_meta.rds"))
print(meta_icc)
print(meta_beta)
cat("\nalpha units q<0.05:", a_alpha[sig == TRUE, .N], "/", nrow(a_alpha),
    "\nbeta units q<0.05:", a_beta[sig == TRUE, .N], "/", nrow(a_beta), "\n")
print(a_alpha[order(index, -ICC),
              .(unit, index, ICC, ICC_lo, ICC_hi, alpha_R2, alpha_P,
                alpha_q)])
print(a_beta[order(-ICC),
             .(unit, ICC, ICC_lo, ICC_hi, alpha_R2, alpha_P, beta_q)])
```

```{r part-a-mantel}
mt <- A$mantel
mt[, z := atanh(mantel_r)]
mt[, se := 1 / sqrt(n_species - 3)]
mf <- meta_fit(mt$z, mt$se)
mt_meta <- data.table(est_r = tanh(mf[["est"]]), lo_r = tanh(mf[["lo"]]),
                      hi_r = tanh(mf[["hi"]]), tau2 = mf[["tau2"]],
                      I2 = mf[["I2"]], k = mf[["k"]])
print(mt[order(-mantel_r)])
print(mt_meta)
```

```{r part-b-meta}
bmeta <- rbindlist(lapply(c("source", "country", "extract", "IF_SD",
                            "platform"), function(tn) {
  d <- B$effects[term == tn]
  if (tn %in% c("extract", "IF_SD"))
    d <- d[!(Genus == "Phaseolus" & Region == "ITS1")]
  mf <- meta_fit(d$delta, d$se)
  data.table(term = tn, est = mf[["est"]], lo = mf[["lo"]],
             hi = mf[["hi"]], tau2 = mf[["tau2"]], I2 = mf[["I2"]],
             k = mf[["k"]])
}))
B$meta <- bmeta
saveRDS(B[c("effects", "adonis", "composition", "pool_def", "meta")],
        rds_b)
print(B$composition)
print(bmeta)
print(B$effects[term == "source"][order(-delta),
                                  .(pool, n, delta, lo, hi, R2, P)])
print(B$adonis[pool == "Brassica x V4"])
```

# 5. Tables / 结果表

```{r tables}
term_lab <- c(source = "Study source", country = "Country",
              extract = "Tissue", IF_SD = "Sterilisation",
              platform = "Platform")
col_map <- c(source = "source", country = "Country", extract = "extract",
             IF_SD = "IF_SD", platform = "PlatformN")
ut <- copy(A$units)
ut[, n_samples := A$samples[, .N, by = unit][match(ut$unit, unit), N]]
ut[, n_genera := A$samples[, uniqueN(Genus), by = unit][
  match(ut$unit, unit), V1]]
ut[, n_species := A$samples[, uniqueN(species), by = unit][
  match(ut$unit, unit), V1]]
ut[, n_countries := A$samples[, uniqueN(Country), by = unit][
  match(ut$unit, unit), V1]]
ut[, covars := ae[index == "Shannon"][match(ut$unit, unit), covars]]
ut[, tissue := A$samples[, paste(sort(unique(extract)), collapse = "+"),
                         by = unit][match(ut$unit, unit), V1]]
ut[, sterilization := A$samples[, paste(sort(unique(IF_SD)), collapse = "+"),
                                by = unit][match(ut$unit, unit), V1]]
ut[, platform := A$samples[, paste(sort(unique(PlatformN)), collapse = "+"),
                           by = unit][match(ut$unit, unit), V1]]
write_tab(ut, CHAPTER, "Tab_2_partA_units")
```

```{r fig-helpers}
reg_lab <- c(V3_V4 = "V3-V4", V4 = "V4", V5_V6 = "V5-V6", V5_V7 = "V5-V7",
             ITS1 = "ITS1", ITS2 = "ITS2")
REG4 <- setNames(REG_COL[c("V4", "V5_V7", "ITS1", "ITS2")],
                 c("V4", "V5-V7", "ITS1", "ITS2"))
meta_txt2 <- function(m) {
  if (is.na(m$tau2)) return("no~pooled~estimate")
  sprintf("I^2 == %d*\"%%,\" ~ tau^2 == %.2f",
          round(m$I2), m$tau2)
}

forest_panel_h <- function(d, ylab, meta_row, col_map,
                           show_x = TRUE, ylim = NULL,
                           legend = "none") {
  d <- copy(as.data.table(d))
  k <- nrow(d)
  d[, x := seq_len(k)]
  if (is.null(ylim)) {
    ylim <- range(c(d$lo, d$hi, 0, meta_row$lo, meta_row$hi), na.rm = TRUE)
    pad <- diff(ylim) * 0.06
    ylim <- ylim + c(-pad, pad)
  }
  xd <- k + 1.05
  dx <- 0.20
  dm <- data.frame(
    x = c(xd, xd + dx, xd, xd - dx),
    y = c(meta_row$lo, meta_row$est, meta_row$hi, meta_row$est)
  )
  ann_y <- ylim[2] - 0.02 * diff(ylim)
  ggplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_segment(data = d,
                 aes(x = x, xend = x, y = lo, yend = hi,
                     colour = reg4),
                 linewidth = 0.45, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = d, aes(x = x, y = est, fill = reg4),
               shape = 21, size = 2.8, stroke = 0.3) +
    geom_polygon(data = dm, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = k + 1.38, y = ann_y,
             label = meta_txt2(meta_row), parse = TRUE,
             hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 2.8) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_len(k),
                       labels = if (show_x) d$lab else rep("", k),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(4)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.4, k + 1.45), ylim = ylim) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = col_map, name = "Region") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = col_map, name = "Region") +
    labs(x = if (show_x) "Study (host genus count)" else NULL, y = ylab) +
    theme_seed(8) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = if (show_x)
            element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 12)
          else element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = if (show_x) element_line() else element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.position = legend,
          legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.key.size = unit(2.8, "mm"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8))
}
```

```{r partb-pcoa}
# Per-pool PCoA for the same-Genus cross-study figure.  Distances are
# recomputed from the region CSS tables and cached because the plot chunk is
# otherwise cheap to re-run.
pb_rds <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "partB_pcoa.rds")
if (file.exists(pb_rds) && !FORCE) {
  PB <- readRDS(pb_rds)
} else {
  pdef <- copy(B$pool_def)
  PB <- rbindlist(lapply(unique(pdef$Region), function(reg) {
    rd <- load_region(reg)
    out <- list()
    for (k in which(pdef$Region == reg)) {
      gen <- pdef$Genus[k]
      m <- rd$meta[Genus == gen]
      idx <- match(m$SampleID, rownames(rd$mat))
      D <- as.matrix(vegdist(rd$mat[idx, , drop = FALSE], "bray"))
      pc <- cmdscale(D, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
      eigp <- pc$eig[pc$eig > 0]
      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- data.table(
        pool = pdef$pool[k], dataset = pdef$dataset[k], Region = reg,
        Genus = gen, SampleID = m$SampleID, source = m$source,
        Country = m$Country,
        PCoA1 = pc$points[, 1], PCoA2 = pc$points[, 2],
        var1 = 100 * eigp[1] / sum(eigp),
        var2 = 100 * eigp[2] / sum(eigp))
    }
    rm(rd); invisible(gc())
    rbindlist(out)
  }))
  saveRDS(PB, pb_rds)
}
cat("Part B PCoA:", nrow(PB), "samples;", uniqueN(PB$pool), "pools\n")
```

```{r mixed-adonis}
# Mixed-pool PERMANOVA: bray ~ Host Genus + source + Other,
# with Other = interaction(Country, IF_SD, PlatformN) and by = "margin".
# 合并池 PERMANOVA：三个固定效应，Other 为三个设计变量的交互；按边际检验。
# The server result (1999 permutations, 200 threads) is read by default;
# local recomputation requires SEED_ALLOW_SERVER_RECOMPUTE=true.
# 默认读取服务器结果；本地重算需显式允许。
MIXED_NPERM <- 1999L
MIXED_NCORE <- SEED_NCORE
mixed_rds <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "mixed_pool_adonis.rds")
term_disp <- c(Genus = "Host Genus", source = "Source", Other = "Other")

mixed_design <- function(reg) {
  ds <- if (reg == "its1") "ITS" else "16S"
  bd <- readRDS(bray_path(reg))
  labs <- attr(bd, "Labels")
  m <- md_all[dataset == ds][match(labs, SampleID)]
  stopifnot(nrow(m) == length(labs), all(!is.na(m$SampleID)))
  m[, Other := interaction(Country, IF_SD, PlatformN, drop = TRUE, sep = "|")]
  keep <- complete.cases(m[, .(Genus, source, Country, IF_SD, PlatformN)])
  m <- m[keep]; labs <- labs[keep]
  design <- data.frame(
    Genus  = droplevels(factor(m$Genus)),
    source = droplevels(factor(m$source)),
    Other  = droplevels(factor(m$Other)))
  rownames(design) <- labs
  list(dist = as.dist(as.matrix(bd)[keep, keep, drop = FALSE]),
       design = design, labels = labs, reg = reg)
}

run_mixed_adonis <- function(nperm = MIXED_NPERM, ncore = MIXED_NCORE) {
  rbindlist(lapply(c("v4", "v5_v7", "its1"), function(reg) {
    x <- mixed_design(reg)
    D <- x$dist
    set.seed(20261120)
    ad <- adonis2(D ~ Genus + source + Other, data = x$design,
                  by = "margin", permutations = nperm, parallel = ncore)
    at <- as.data.frame(ad); at$term <- rownames(at)
    at <- at[!at$term %in% c("Residual", "Total"), ]
    data.table(Region = reg, term = at$term, Df = at$Df,
               SumOfSqs = at$SumOfSqs, R2 = at$R2, F = at$F,
               P = at$`Pr(>F)`, n = nrow(x$design),
               n_genus = nlevels(x$design$Genus),
               n_source = nlevels(x$design$source),
               n_other = nlevels(x$design$Other),
               nperm = nperm, ncore = ncore)
  }))
}

if (file.exists(mixed_rds) && !FORCE) {
  MAD <- readRDS(mixed_rds)
  cat("mixed-pool adonis loaded from server_result / 读取服务器结果\n")
} else if (ALLOW_SERVER_RECOMPUTE) {
  MAD <- run_mixed_adonis()
  saveRDS(MAD, mixed_rds)
} else {
  stop("mixed_pool_adonis.rds is missing; provide server_result/ch2/ or set ",
       "SEED_ALLOW_SERVER_RECOMPUTE=true.", call. = FALSE)
}
write_tab(MAD, CHAPTER, "Tab_2_mixed_pool_adonis")
print(MAD)
```

```{r fig-mixed-pool}
# Host Order colours follow the Chapter 1 host tree: orders are ordered by
# their first appearance along the pruned tree tips, and colours are assigned
# in that order from PAL_MULTI (exported by Ch1 to host_order_colors.tsv).
ocm <- fread(file.path(tree_dir("ch1_dataset"), "host_order_colors.tsv"))
mix <- rbindlist(lapply(c("v4", "v5_v7", "its1"), function(reg) {
  x <- mixed_design(reg)
  pc <- cmdscale(x$dist, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
  eigp <- pc$eig[pc$eig > 0]
  ds <- if (reg == "its1") "ITS" else "16S"
  m <- md_all[dataset == ds][match(x$labels, SampleID)]
  data.table(Region = reg, Order = m$Order,
             PCoA1 = pc$points[, 1], PCoA2 = pc$points[, 2],
             var1 = 100 * eigp[1] / sum(eigp),
             var2 = 100 * eigp[2] / sum(eigp))
}))
present <- unique(mix$Order[!is.na(mix$Order)])
extra   <- setdiff(present, ocm$Order)
ord_present <- c(ocm$Order[ocm$Order %in% present], sort(extra))
mix[, Order := factor(Order, levels = ord_present)]
mix[, Region := factor(c(v4 = "V4", v5_v7 = "V5-V7", its1 = "ITS1")[Region],
                       levels = c("V4", "V5-V7", "ITS1"))]
mix_col <- setNames(ocm$colour[match(ord_present, ocm$Order)], ord_present)
if (length(extra))
  mix_col[extra] <- PAL_MULTI[nrow(ocm) + seq_along(extra)]
stopifnot(!anyNA(mix_col), !anyDuplicated(mix_col))

fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "",
                     ifelse(p <= 0.001, "***",
                     ifelse(p <= 0.01, "**",
                     ifelse(p <= 0.05, "*", "ns"))))
ann <- rbindlist(lapply(levels(mix$Region), function(rg) {
  r <- c("V4" = "v4", "V5-V7" = "v5_v7", "ITS1" = "its1")[[rg]]
  d <- copy(MAD[Region == r])
  d[, name := term_disp[term]]
  d <- d[order(-R2)]
  data.table(Region = factor(rg, levels = levels(mix$Region)),
             lab = paste(sprintf("%-10s R²=%.3f %s",
                                 d$name, d$R2, fmt_p(d$P)),
                         collapse = "\n"))
}))

pcoa_panels <- lapply(levels(mix$Region), function(rg) {
  d <- mix[Region == rg]
  a <- ann[Region == rg]
  ggplot(d, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = Order), size = 2.55, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = mix_col, breaks = ord_present,
                        name = "Host Order", na.value = "#9E9E9E",
                        drop = FALSE) +
    annotate("label", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = a$lab,
             hjust = 1.02, vjust = 1.1, size = 3.2, lineheight = 1.0,
             fill = "white", colour = "black", fontface = "plain") +
    labs(x = sprintf("PCoA1 (%.2f%%)", d$var1[1]),
         y = sprintf("PCoA2 (%.2f%%)", d$var2[1]),
         title = rg) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 16.5),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 16.5),
          legend.key = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none")
})
# Build the shared legend from a plot that contains every Order level.
# ggarrange(common.legend = TRUE) takes the legend from the first panel; with
# drop = FALSE that keeps labels but not keys for Orders absent from V4.
leg_df <- data.frame(PCoA1 = 0, PCoA2 = 0,
                     Order = factor(ord_present, levels = ord_present))
leg_p <- ggplot(leg_df, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, colour = Order)) +
  geom_point(shape = 16, size = 2.55, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = mix_col, breaks = ord_present, drop = FALSE,
                      name = "Host Order") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(
    ncol = 2, byrow = FALSE,
    override.aes = list(shape = 16, size = 2.55, alpha = 0.7))) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11))
leg <- cowplot::get_legend(leg_p)

p <- ggpubr::ggarrange(plotlist = pcoa_panels, ncol = 3,
                       common.legend = FALSE, align = "h",
                       legend.grob = leg, legend = "right")
save_fig(p, CHAPTER, "Fig_2_mixed_pool_pcoa", 483, 136.8)
embed_fig(CHAPTER, "Fig_2_mixed_pool_pcoa")
```
